messages.ko: 정하연 입주 1주년이라지? 정말 엊그제 입주한거같은데 어느새 1년이란 시간이 흘렀구나 정말 시간이 야속하군 하지만 입주 초반때 어색어색 쑥스쑥스 하연이가 어렴풋이 기억이 나며 그땐 그랬지 웃음이 나기도 하는군 핳 트리플에스가 된건 내 인생에 행운일것이야 트리플에스… 평생 함께 지냈으면 좋겠네!!
messages.en: Jeong Hayeon’s 1st move-in anniversary, is it? It really feels like I just moved in the other day, but already a year has passed. Time really is indifferent. But the awkward and shy Hayeon from the early days of moving in faintly comes to mind. Back then, I was like that, and it makes me laugh sometimes 핳. Becoming part of tripleS is a blessing in my life. tripleS… I hope we stay together for a lifetime!!
